description: Find real working examples of an API, library, or code pattern on GitHub with `gh search code` and `gh search repos`, then read the best (most starred) implementations. ALWAYS load this skill before guessing how an unfamiliar API, library option, config key, or language feature is used, when docs are thin, or when an implementation keeps failing. Real code from credible repos beats guessing from memory and prevents hallucinated APIs.
